title: Excel plan template
description: Logical content of the 'xlsx-plan-v1' workbook: metadata sheet (base plan_version_id, checksum, head expected_revision) and the editable allocation table. Workbooks contain no macros, external links or formulas except cells the template marks formula-tolerant. The instrument_id CASH is reserved: the row with instrument_id CASH holds the plan's cash weight (plan content allocation.cash_weight), is never a tradable instrument and never appears in allocation.weights; at most one CASH row is allowed.

instrument_id.description: Instrument identifier, or the reserved value CASH for the cash-weight row (CASH is not an instrument and is never written to allocation.weights).

allocation_rows.description: Editable allocation table, one row per instrument plus the reserved CASH row (the cash weight). The target weights of all rows, CASH included, sum to 1 within the validation tolerance.
